TURO OPS ASSISTANT

Alert settings

Emails Colorado Cruisers the moment a guest books the Premier protection plan on an upcoming trip ($0 out-of-pocket, so damage can't be billed to them), plus a nightly turnover report at 9 PM Colorado time covering every other flagged trip.

Gmail lists an inline logo as an attachment on the message — that is how inline images work and it cannot be avoided. Turn this off for a plain typographic header and no attachment. Takes effect on the next alert; nothing needs redeploying.

Setup

  1. Go to script.google.com and create a new project.
  2. Replace the contents of Code.gs with the script below.
  3. Set SHEET_ID if you want a log, or leave it blank.
  4. Deploy → New deployment → Web app. Set Execute as to Me, and Who has access to Anyone.
  5. Authorize it, copy the /exec URL, paste it above, and hit Send test alert.

Updating the script later: paste the new code, then Deploy → Manage deployments → pencil icon → Version: New version → Deploy. Saving the code alone does not change what the /exec URL runs — that's why an edit can look like it did nothing. The URL stays the same, so you never re-paste it here.

"Anyone" means anyone holding the URL can post to it — it can send email but can't read your Google account. Treat the URL as a password, and redeploy to rotate it if it ever leaks.
